newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares dip, Hoiu, Foreks buck trend.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares dip, Hoiu, Foreks buck trend.

text.p: Most Estonian shares eased slightly on Monday by the close of trade although Forekspank and Hoiupank bucked the trend to make more gains.
Dealers said the stock exchange, which has seen almost two weeks of record highs, could suffer a bout of selling on Tuesday.
Total trade on the main list was 71.1 million kroons with the Talse index ending 0.36 percent lower at 349.97.
"Prices are very high now and we expect sellers to be more active tomorrow; they started to move today," one trader said.
Both Forekspank and Hoiupank made strong gains, still benefiting from good first-half figures and expectations for profit forecast upgrades.
But dealers said the rise was also driven by low liquidity.
Forekspank was the most active stock with 20 million kroons traded to close 7.50 kroons higher on 230.00. Hoiupank added 3.50 to close on 207.50 kroons on trade of 16.4 million kroons.
On the over-the-counter free market, trade was more subdued with only 3.8 million kroons traded.
Norma, an automotive safety belt manufacturer, was the most active to gain slightly on trade worth 2.1 million kroons.
Norma was 0.50 kroons higher to close on 90 kroons a rsie of 0.50 kroons.
